notes.title: Perf and Audio Settings Patch
notes.content:
Today we have some more fixes and improvements.

Changes:
- Fixed an issue with some player desyncs.
- Fixed the green trees in the main menu.
- The locked UI in VR in the main menu is no longer locked.
- Greatly boosted performance as it was before.
- Improved Dynamic Resolution stability.

- Implemented basic audio settings.

notes.title: Graphical enhancements, stable framerates, co-op fix, and more.
notes.content:
Today is a much welcome change.

Fixes:
- Items no longer desync when dropped in co-op.
- Fixed bug where monster would sometimes trigger a chase but not actually chase.

Enhancements:
- Change the dynamic resolution upscale method to TAA for improved image quality.
- Underlying engine upgrade which will boost the overall visual fidelity across the board.
- Stabilized the FPS for a smoother experience.
- Improved vegetation animations.

Other:
- The monster is now more obvious about when it's warning you to keep back.
- Monster speed boosted during prowling.
- The delay from the monster warning you and deciding to chase you is now reduced slightly with a further reduction based on stress level.

notes.title: Dynamic Resolution Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where dynamic resolution might downscale when it shouldn't, needlessly lowering the image quality.

notes.title: Graphical Enhancements
notes.content:
Today I bring to you another patch with graphical enhancements and bugfixing.

Enhancements:
- Improved shadows across the board.
- Improved lighting in the main menu and the lobby.
- Blended the visibility boxes better inside the maze walls.
- Fixed another screen tearing issue.
- Reduced noise on volumetrics.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a material bug causing pink texture to display near the secret room on John's Corn Maze.
- Fixed a bug that rarely caused the rune to spawn at the entrance of the maze.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Bamboo Thicket map to not correctly reset the round timer.

Other:
- The cryptid and music box can now be heard from further away.
- The music box now fades in volume quicker to be much more subtle at a distance.


Up next is more co-op improvements and bug fixes.  In addition, co-op voice will be added, which was the main reason audio settings were not yet implemented.  Both will be added together.

notes.title: Bamboo Thicket Update, State of Snipe Hunt and future plans.
notes.content:
Today I have the Bamboo Thicket Update.  Introduced is a new map with new theming.  The Bamboo Thicket is the next step up in the map progression and is sure to give you more spooks and thrills.  It is now added to the random rotation of maps on the job board.

In addition to the new map we have the following bug fixes and enhancements:
- Player no longer spins when UI becomes locked such as when entering a menu.
- Fixed an issue that sometimes caused some objects to pop into view around corners.
- Improved the visuals on the main menu.
- Added a size rating mechanic for maps.  This indicates how large the maze is in the mission and adjusts the stress gain rate to compensate fairly.  Larger maps build up stress slower.

State of the Game:
Currently the main breaking bugs have been dealt with in singleplayer outright.  If there is still a major bug in singleplayer that hasn't been addressed, please let me know with a bug report.

Co-op still has a few bugs yet but is playable.  The main known bugs to deal with have to do with item desyncs on item drop and leaving a mission from the menu.  The player animations are a bit goofy yet so get your laughs in while you can.

VR works fine in singleplayer with some caveats.  WMR is still not officially supported but has been reported to work if you set your device to use the OpenXR API, not in the game but for your device itself.  Roomscale users will need to reset your origin if you move a significant distance from it after a scene loads.  Using a vial on footprints is still awkward yet.

VR in Co-op is pretty broken and needs some significant fixes before it's ready yet.

Plans for the Future:
The immediate plan is to finish up fixing the Co-op and VR Co-op bugs followed by a QoL patch to make the VR experience more enjoyable.  After that I plan to implement one more map before beginning work on a progression system to further enhance the experience.

notes.content:

After this patch I intend to start slipping in content updates alongside of bugfix patches.  Thank you for all of the support, especially those of you who helped track down these bugs.

notes.title: Snipe Hunt Launch
notes.content:
After a long and grueling journey, Snipe Hunt has officially launched.  I hope it was well worth the wait.  I will be addressing critical bugs in the immediate future as they arise.  Please, please, please report them if you find any.  You can report them at the community hub's discussion board or the game's discord server.  After things stabilize I will be turning my attention to content updates shortly after.

Happy hunting~
  - Drac

notes.title: Snipe Hunt Launch on Oct 24
notes.content:
The launch has been postponed until Oct 24 to give time to make the product a better experience for everyone.  I hate to announce a delay but I would much rather put out a quality game rather than rush the release.  The extra time will be put to good use making sure there's less bugs, more content, and more polish.  I look forward to seeing you then.

Sincerely
- Drac

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Speedrun Contest
notes.content:
In the spirit of the Next Fest, we are going to have a little contest to get hyped up.  The challenge is to speedrun the demo version of Snipe Hunt, capturing the monster as fast as is possible without relying on lucky guessing.  No VR submissions for this contest but a later contest might be tailored to VR users.

Rules:
[list]
[*] Must find enough evidence to deduce which cryptid is the monster.  No random guesses but logical deductions are fine.
[*] Must place the trap and successfully capture the monster.
[*] Must find the music box and exit the maze with it in inventory.
[*] Time starts when you close the opening letter from Norman and ends when you confirm exiting the maze.  The demo will display the time then.
[*] Bugs may be exploited for this contest but no modifications or outside tool assistance is allowed.
[*] Submissions must be recorded and hosted in an uncut video format hosted on either YouTube or the game's Community Hub.
[*] Post your submission in a discussion in the game's community hub for verification.
[/list]


The best verified times for [b]each[/b] cryptid type will receive the following:
[list]
[*] Four full keys to the full version of the game(one for you and three for your friends).
[*] A special role to recognize your accomplishment on our discord server.
[*] An invitation into future beta tests beyond what the demo will provide.
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/szrv9Zz]Discord Link[/url]

I wish you luck during the contest and hope you catch many cryptids!

notes.title: Snipe Hunt Demo Release
notes.content:
Snipe Hunt's demo which was released not long ago has finally started to stabilize.  You can get it at any time to try out the game.  The demo focuses on a single playable level and emphasizes the core gameplay loop.  So far that includes:

[list]
[*] Procedural mazes
[*] Testing footprints
[*] Testing bones
[*] Using the goggles item to check for runes
[*] Runestone sack, a breadcrumbs item to help mark your way
[*] Evidence checklist
[*] Monster AI and basic mechanics
[*] Seated VR Support(optional)
[/list]

More will be added as the Next Fest approaches and we will have new information soon.
